cohort: 300 pregnant women recruited from a tertiary care hospital.
finding: High maternal intake of micronutrients and macronutrients was significantly correlated with positive neonatal outcomes such as higher birth weights and improved Apgar scores, while a low intake was associated with lower birth weights and reduced Apgar scores.
cross-section timing: Maternal diet data collected during the third trimester, and neonatal health outcomes recorded at birth.
